nonClaims: D11.1 does not change D11's NOT_SUPPORTED verdict or audit PASS.
D11.1 does not claim that arbitrary float32 motion can be rounded safely; the quantizer rejects every component farther than 1/1024 pixel from an integer.
D11.1 does not validate perspective, subpixel, deformation, transparency, volumetrics, hair, motion blur or depth of field.
D11.1 does not validate Cryptomatte or multi-owner pixels; ownership is opaque Object Index only.
D11.1 does not claim that temporal averaging improves image quality; it validates a bounded dataflow and rejection contract only.
D11.1 does not claim cinematic quality, character consistency or human preference.
D11.1 does not claim cross-version, cross-operating-system, cross-CPU or cross-GPU equivalence.
A supported D11.1 would not authorize production rendering, unattended execution or radius widening.
